content:
**Charred Scorchbeast Liver** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

The liver of a Scorchbeast, cooked over a fire.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Scorchbeast Liver | | Charred Scorchbeast Liver (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked up a Scorchbeast Liver for the first time.
